acceptance.desc: 安裝版34：codesign deep strict、執行檔 cmp 一致、行程恰1、詞庫雜湊不變

evidence.cmd: APP="$HOME/Library/Input Methods/PhonicKeyboard.app"; test "$(plutil -extract CFBundleVersion raw "$APP/Contents/Info.plist")" = 34 && codesign --verify --deep --strict "$APP" && cmp "$HOME/Library/Caches/PhonicKeyboardBuild/PhonicKeyboard.app/Contents/MacOS/PhonicKeyboard" "$APP/Contents/MacOS/PhonicKeyboard" && test "$(pgrep -f "$APP/Contents/MacOS/PhonicKeyboard" | wc -l | tr -d " ")" = 1 && cmp workingfiles/outputs/capsled_probe_2026-09-05/v34_pre.txt workingfiles/outputs/capsled_probe_2026-09-05/v34_post.txt
